[SWS_CRYPT_20615]
{DRAFT}
⌈
The
X.509 Provider
shall verify self-signed cer-
tificates besides
PKI
based signatures. The
CryptoAPI
provides methods to specify
the certificate and the used cryptographic algorithm. Based on the algorithm the
X.-
509 Provider
compares the given signature with the calculated one. If both are
matching, the certificate is valid. Otherwise, the
X.509 Provider
will return an er-
ror.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02306)
